basic_info.description: Bright and spacious DETACHED Merced Manor home just short blocks from Stonestown Galleria, YMCA, Lakeside Presbyterian Center for Children (daycare/preschool), both pubic & private schools, San Francisco State University, Stern Grove Park, Lakeside Village eateries & shops, Lake Merced, and Lakeshore Shopping Center. Enjoy easy access to MUNI lines, 19th Ave public transit, and other nearby conveniences. This sun-filled home is bathed in natural light from all four sides. The upper level boasts a spacious east-facing living room with a fireplace, formal dining room, updated kitchen with a large private breakfast nook or office that opens to a cozy balcony, plus two generous bedrooms, including a primary suite with a full bath and an additional full bath. An interior staircase leads to the expansive ground floor, featuring a large family room with a fireplace, two bedrooms, 1.5 baths, a dedicated laundry area, and a two-car side-by-side garage plus two car side-by-side in the driveway accessed via the back alley. A separate side entrance provides convenient access to the lower level. Enjoy the beautifully manicured front and private backyard!
